questions.subject: Bihar-Specific
questions.body: Which district holds Bihar's highest population density AND its smallest area, a striking combination given the two would usually be expected to trade off against each other only loosely?
questions.explanation: Sheohar is both Bihar's smallest district by area and its most densely populated (around 1,880 people per sq km) -- a notable combination, since Patna, despite being the state's most populous and urbanised district overall, does not hold the density record; Kaimur, by contrast, has the state's lowest population density.
